concerns.text: The “Dataset Strategy” table lists verified source URLs that **do not contain** the required resting‑state fMRI time‑series or NIH Toolbox Dimensional Change Card Sort scores (e.g., “https://huggingface.co/datasets/7eu7d7/HCP-Diffusion-datas/...”, “https://huggingface.co/datasets/timm/nih-chest-xray-14/...”). These datasets are unrelated (diffusion MRI or chest‑X‑ray data), making them inappropriate for the research question. The plan’s Phase 0 data‑gap check will inevitably fail, preventing any downstream analysis.
